fixture.format: six little-endian u32 parameters followed by 3,600 little-endian u32 input/event records

workloads.adapter: The demo replays retained 600-frame checkpoints through Canvas 2D; complete trace oracles remain textual.

fixture.format: little-endian header, tile bytes, entity records, path requests, and control records

workloads.adapter: The demo replays retained 300-frame ECS checkpoints through Canvas 2D; complete path and host-command oracles remain textual.

fixture.format: little-endian header, map bytes, unit records, and 240 action records grouped by 60 encoded turn IDs

workloads.adapter: The demo replays the retained per-turn command state into a DOM grid visual enhancement; complete canonical DOM and accessibility oracles remain textual.

targets.algorithm: All fixture parsing, integer state reduction, A-star/BFS, ECS, trace encoding, and oracle production execute in authored JavaScript.

The same fixture parsing, integer state reduction, A-star/BFS, ECS, trace encoding, and oracle production execute independently in C compiled to fixed-memory linear WebAssembly; JavaScript only copies bytes and decodes the result buffer.

equivalence: The independently authored JavaScript and C-to-linear-Wasm targets consume byte-identical fixtures and match every retained digest, checkpoint, path length, tie-break trace, counter, replay snapshot, and final visual state exactly.
floatingPointPolicy: No floating-point arithmetic occurs in fixture generation, either controlled reducer, counters, digests, or the Wasm module. Canvas drawing is an untimed visual adapter outside the oracle.

rights.detail: All fixtures and visuals are generated by repository code; no external media, fonts, audio, or user data are read.

unavailable.reason: Validation records contain outputs and counters only; no durations are collected.
Canonical audio-event streams are validated, but the demo does not create an AudioContext or play sound.
